objective: Falsify whether changes in physically backed GLD gold holdings provide a low-turnover XAU demand component before StrategyQuant.
causal_premise: Persistent creations or redemptions of shares in the largest physical gold ETF represent investor demand or supply that may continue beyond the contemporaneous price move.

data.source: Official SPDR Gold Shares NYSE Historical Archive XLSX

frozen_rule.publication_buffer: one full weekly observation between holdings factor and entry
frozen_rule.price_proxy: GLD indicative price per share at 4:15pm New York
frozen_rule.position: one trade per contiguous non-flat state; close on flat or reversal

decision_order: Reject without tuning if any train gate fails
Open frozen validation only if all gates pass
Do not calculate modern challenge or sealed holdout early
stop_condition: Do not invert the signal or tune lookback, threshold, delay, costs or direction after seeing train.
